name: Orchestrator basic example
description: Foundational example demonstrating Design creation, sequential and concurrent action execution, timer events and worker binding

name: Orchestrator branching example
description: Illustrates various branching patterns including parallel branch execution and synchronization points

name: Orchestrator catch_error example
description: Demonstrates comprehensive error handling using CatchBuilder, recoverable and non-recoverable error handlers

name: Orchestrator DAG example
description: Demonstrates Directed Acyclic Graph execution with 10 nodes, automatic topological sorting and parallel branch execution

name: Orchestrator events across local programs example
description: Shows event handling and communication between multiple programs within the same process using TriggerBuilder and SyncBuilder

name: Orchestrator shutdown example
description: Demonstrates proper program lifecycle management with start and stop actions and graceful shutdown events

name: Orchestrator shutdown using signals example
description: Shows how to handle SIGINT and SIGTERM system signals for signal-driven graceful shutdown
